name: elf_php_dropper
description: A static x86-64 ELF program in cgi-bin that fetches a PHP payload with wget -O. Realtime does not read program files; the scans catch it with YARA and leave it in place because yara_match_scheduled is on neither scan quarantine list.
provenance: internal/yara/elf_web_dropper_test.go TestELFWebPayloadDropperRule (static program fetching a PHP payload with wget)

realtime.gap: realtime does not read a program's content; an executable written to a doc root is only tracked in case it deletes itself
